kpis.description_en: UK + Canada operations. Small vs USA but steady growth. Acquired Sirius (USA) + Misco UK/Canada Q3 2021.

kpis.description_en: CDW Corporation total net sales: 4 segments (Corporate, Small Business, Public, Other UK/Canada). Peak FY22 at $23.7B, trough FY24, growth recovery FY25 driven by Healthcare and Small Business.

kpis.description_en: Corporate segment FY25 = 42.1% of total revenue. Primarily serves US private sector >250 employees. Historically largest CDW segment, more volatile (B2B IT cycle).

kpis.description_en: Public segment FY25 = 38.1% of revenue. FY25 mix: Government $2,590M, Education $3,110M, Healthcare $2,836M. Healthcare strong growth +13%, Education slight decline -1.8%.

kpis.signal: 12% du CA, operations CDW UK et CDW Canada, croissance +9,7% FY25

kpis.description_en: Other segment = CDW UK + CDW Canada (does not meet reportable segment thresholds). 12.1% of FY25 revenue, growth +9.7%. Segment operating margin 5.7%.

kpis.description_en: Operating income FY25 $1,656M, margin 7.4%. Breakdown: Corp $889M, Small Business $203M, Public $750M, Other $154M, less Headquarters costs $(341)M. Margin compression vs 7.9% FY24.
